name: Places
description: This app allows you to search for places on Google Maps around a certain location. It requires a Places API key that you can create on GCP.
author: thooton

changes.text: Work finishing after the app closes or starts over is dropped.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Set up from a setup file, the user's own Maps key or a command center; no login built in.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Dropped-pin links show the coordinates and the nearest address.
A slip in the Command center dialog keeps it open with what you typed.
One Back now drops a Near edit, and leaving the app mid-edit no longer keeps the half-typed place.
A missing key or book account names the command center route that sets it.
